scope: LogFile streaming regression controls, including rotating and nonrotating replay
controls: ordered replay and append position with active-segment offsets and chain heads
read-only missing stream creates no files or directories
read-only torn-tail inspection then active-tail repair preserving sealed files
missing newline recovery and subsequent append separation
invalid middle chain and corrupt sealed segment fatal without mutation
visitor error propagates without usable recovered handle
recovery sync failure after private visitation returns error, then real reopen recovers
